pages.heading: TDK D60
pages.text:
Label, in Arthur's hand:

STUDY / 11

Don't.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Tape eleven. The study. It's raining, which in this town means it's a day.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: I measured the north wall again. Same number. Wrong number.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: If you hear knocking from inside the walls, don't answer.

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: ...I checked. There is nothing in there that could knock.
